newsitem.title: USA: Buckle November same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Buckle November same-store sales up.

text.p: Buckle Inc said Thursday its same-store sales for the four weeks ended November 30 rose 4.4 percent from the same period last year.
Total sales for the period were up 14.6 percent, to $18.2 million from $15.9 million last year.
Year-to-date, net sales for the 43 weeks ended November 30 increased 22.3 percent, to $162.5 million from $132.8 million in 1995. Comparable-store sales for the year to date were up 12.5 percent.
Buckle Inc is a retailer of casual apparel for young men and women. It has 181 stores in 22 states.
